items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Doc Cheatham, Budd Johnson, Vic Dickinson, Connie Kay, Wally Richardson, and on another date, Jackie Williams. That was the group.

ctx.x: Now, who was on the record? How many pieces did you use?
Doc Cheatham, Budd Johnson, Vic Dickinson, Connie Kay, Wally Richardson, and on another date, Jackie Williams. That was the group.
And as you said, it was the same music for the record as for the sound track.
